trigger: Direct user correction before TASK-P12B-990: code regression is not Cost Router quality completion.

root_causes.finding: The v1 DeepSeek request enabled json_object mode but did not deliver the complete itinerary JSON Schema to the model.
Both v1 adapters accepted any JSON object; typed and business validation happened after the adapter, and live calibration reduced failures to one boolean.
The v1 Gemini adapter collapsed HTTP 400, 401, 403 and 404 into llm.provider_rejected, so the three historic rejections cannot be disambiguated from retained content-free evidence.
Provider-reported usage was discarded when JSON was incomplete, invalid or rejected by a local output contract.

implemented_repairs: DeepSeek receives the complete canonical JSON Schema in a fixed system message while preserving the same user prompt hash used by the paired arm.
Gemini and DeepSeek run the same closed local JSON Schema validator and the same itinerary business-rule validator before returning ModelResult.
AdapterFailure carries only finite rule codes, output hash and provider usage; no prompt, response or reasoning content is retained.
Gemini errors are classified as request_invalid, model_not_found, provider_unauthenticated, provider_permission_denied, provider_account, rate_limited or unavailable.
The calibration ledger charges provider-reported tokens even when output validation fails.
The v2 paired diagnostic disables retries and fallback so four scenarios produce at most eight calls with identical denominators.
